lead: Small GIS tasks I can take on at my current skill level as a BS Geo-Informatics student.
scopeNote: Project scope, data availability and validation requirements are discussed before any work begins.

services.title: Thematic mapping and map layout design
services.summary: Thematic maps and finished layouts from data you provide.
includes: Choosing symbology and classes that suit the data
A layout with title, legend, scale bar and north arrow

services.title: Basic GIS data cleaning and digitization
services.summary: Digitizing features and tidying basic spatial data.
includes: Digitizing features from imagery or existing maps
Basic clean-up of geometry and attributes

services.title: Spatial analysis and buffer/service-area mapping
services.summary: Buffer, overlay and service-area style analysis with a map of the result.
includes: Service-area mapping where a suitable road network is available

services.title: Remote-sensing index calculation (NDVI/NDBI)
services.summary: NDVI or NDBI maps from satellite imagery, where data and scope are suitable.
includes: NDVI or NDBI calculation from suitable imagery
A map of the result for the agreed area
services.limits: Needs suitable imagery and a clear scope. Validation requirements are agreed first.

services.title: Simple WebGIS map development with Leaflet
services.summary: A simple interactive web map built with Leaflet.
includes: A web map built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Leaflet.js
services.limits: Hosting and data sources are discussed at the start.

services.title: GIS workflow documentation and map/report formatting
services.summary: Clear written documentation of a GIS workflow, with maps and tables formatted for a report.
includes: Formatting maps and tables for a report
